headline: 'Investment Jackpot' Insurers Break 9 Trillion Won in First-Half Net Profit
summary: Domestic insurers' first-half net income reached 9,013.8 billion won, up 13.0% year on year, driven by investment income and non-life insurance income. Premium income rose 8.5%.
why: Insurers are large institutional investors, and their investment income and underwriting results reflect conditions in South Korea's financial markets.
